steps.title: Inspect multilingual recognition settings
steps.body: Read the language and model controls for Whisper Multilingual. Auto-detection suits varied languages; choosing a language can make a controlled test easier to interpret. These are recognition settings within the provider page, not a separate tab. A loaded backend and recorded speech are needed to verify transcription.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Verify with a short spoken phrase
steps.body: Recognition settings only show intent. Verification requires speaking a short phrase in the target language and reading the transcript. If words are dropped or mistranslated, re-check language choice before adjusting other recognition values.
steps.target_hint: This control may depend on available content or a loaded addon. Read the step here; no service or provider is enabled by the guide.

steps.title: Local model prerequisites
steps.body: This backend runs locally through faster-whisper, so the environment must be able to load the model. If recognition never returns a transcript, confirm the model is available before assuming settings are wrong. Provide the required setup rather than expecting network access.
